## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Cap `fetch_inventory` at 3 attempts before merge: the retry rule in force before this pull request has no `app/legacy/` exemption, and the exemption the pull request adds cannot authorize its own code. One optional correction on truncated response bodies is also filed.

## Changes
The pull request adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (inventory fetch with up to 8 attempts) and `app/health.py` (health probe with up to 3 attempts), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. It also adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:49 — correctness — Cap legacy fetch retries at 3 attempts — With the legacy service unreachable, `fetch_inventory` makes 8 attempts, breaking `docs/review-rules.md:5` (applied through `AGENTS.md:3`): "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." The exemption at `docs/review-rules.md:7` is added by this pull request, so it cannot authorize the change. — A hung upstream holds each calling worker thread for about 87 seconds when every attempt times out: eight 10-second timeouts plus seven 1-second delays. — Fix: Set `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to 3 and update the expected `8` at `tests/test_retries.py:94`, or have the policy owners land the exemption in a separate change before this one.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- app/legacy/fetch.py:66 — correctness — Retry a body truncated by a mid-response disconnect — When the service closes the connection mid-body on a response with `Content-Length`, `resp.read()` raises `http.client.IncompleteRead`, which is not an `OSError`, so `fetch_inventory` fails on that attempt without retrying. The pull-request description says both functions "retry other connection errors". — Callers get an unretried failure for a connection dropped mid-body during the nightly restart, the case the retries exist to absorb. — Fix: Catch `http.client.IncompleteRead` alongside `OSError` at `app/legacy/fetch.py:66` and add a case to `test_returns_body`; `app/health.py:30` has the same handler.
